reason: Verified: the t.Cleanup at internal/amazon/browser_profile_values_test.go:212-219 skips only "" and os.TempDir(), so any other path that profile() (internal/amazon/browser.go:304-323) might return after a regression, such as a persistent default profile directory, would be deleted with os.RemoveAll. That breaks FR-TEST-HYG-055 ("never removes anything other than the temporary profile it was given") and risks data on developer and CI machines. Fix: guard the removal with the subtest's own location check (parent is filepath.Clean(os.TempDir()) and the base name has the prefix pricefollower-browser-), and update the wording of TS-TEST-HYG-071 to match.
